description: Prices private staff from what you pay them. Takes the day or hourly pay, hours per day, overtime threshold and multiplier, employer on-costs %, daily expenses (meals, accommodation, mileage, other), overhead %, and a target margin or markup, then returns the full cost per person per day, the sell price per day and per hour, margin and markup, and totals for the number of staff and days. Holds no market rates: every rate is the caller’s. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/private-staff-day-rate-calculator

distancePerDay.description: Distance travelled per day (miles or km).

marginOnExpenses.description: false = recharge expenses at cost with no margin.

onCostPercent.description: Employer on-costs (holiday pay, payroll taxes, pension, insurance) as % of pay. Country-specific: enter your own. 0 for a freelancer who invoices.

otherExpensesPerDay.description: Other expenses per person per day (parking, tolls, tickets).

overheadPercent.description: Agency or admin overhead as % of direct cost (pay, on-costs, expenses).

overtimeAfterHours.description: Hours per day paid at the normal rate; later hours are overtime. 0 = no overtime.

overtimeMultiplier.description: Overtime pay multiplier (default 1.5 is a modelling choice).

payBasis.description: Whether payRate is per day or per hour.

payRate.description: What you pay the person per day (covering the hours up to overtimeAfterHours) or per hour, before on-costs.

pricingMode.description: Price on a margin (% of sell price) or a markup (% of cost).

pricingPercent.description: Target margin or markup % (default 25% is a modelling choice; margins are capped at 95%).

ratePerDistanceUnit.description: Mileage rate paid per mile or km.

role.description: Role label for the estimate (no market rates are applied).
